description:
Noeul enters university with dreams of studying film, her stomach full of butterflies. There, she meets Juheon, a student with an overwhelming presence that captivates everyone around him. Despite the attention he garners from others, Juheon displays a peculiar attitude towards Noeul—neither purely ill-tempered nor genuinely kind. Caught in a whirlwind of confusing emotions, Noeul finds herself falling into a passionate and feverish romance with Juheon. However, unforeseen circumstances force her to confront a harsh reality, leading to a cold and abrupt breakup. Ten years later, fate brings Noeul and Juheon back together. What will become of their unresolved feelings and unfinished story?

(Source: Lezhin US)
